beats.speaker: nurse-maya
beats.line: Good morning. What brings you in today?

beats.speaker: patient-kenji
beats.line: I have had a cough for six weeks. It is worse at night.

beats.speaker: nurse-maya
beats.line: May I see your BC Services Card, please?

beats.purpose: One coherent card travels from Kenji's hand to Maya's hand across the counter, with ownership, contact, release and placement visible.

beats.speaker: nurse-maya
beats.line: Your provincial coverage is not active, so today's visit may be billed.

beats.speaker: patient-kenji
beats.line: Oh no. Before I see a provider, can you tell me how much the visit would cost me?

beats.speaker: nurse-maya
beats.line: I can't confirm that here. You can review reference fees on the Doctors of BC website, or get an itemized bill after your visit.

beats.purpose: Omitted; Maya's complete final answer carries the outer fade.
